source_anomaly_disclosure: No internal inconsistencies detected - the archive closes against its own physics: the U-234 decay identity (234U/238U)(0) = 1 + ((234U/238U)_measured - 1) x exp(lambda234 x t), with lambda234 = 2.8221e-6/yr, reproduces ALL 54 archived initial ratios (27 raw + 27 corrected) to within 1.3e-4 activity units; noted for the record: ages are declared relative to AD 1950 in the header's own comment, and analyses span three labs and two measurement years with replicate A/B pairs agreeing within their stated errors
purpose: thirty-ninth catalogue entry - the GREAT BARRIER REEF joins as region TWENTY-SEVEN (the catalogue's first drowned-reef boreholes, drilled from its first mission-specific platform) and U-Th radiometric geochronology is kind TWENTY-EIGHT: absolute clocks in the rock, the chronometric backbone under the catalogue's age-depth and varve kinds; the gate re-earns the radiochemistry on every run - the 234U decay identity closes on all 54 initial-ratio cells, every detritally-corrected age is <= its raw age (inherited 230Th only ever makes samples LOOK older), the correction magnitude tracks the 232Th contamination exactly as the physics demands (all 7 rows with 232Th/238U >= 2e-4 correct by >= 0.015 kyr; all 16 rows below 5e-5 correct by <= 0.007 kyr), and every initial ratio sits inside the closed-system seawater window 1.1396-1.1500 - corals that kept their clocks sealed for 25,000 years
verified: 27 rows / 486 counted cells against the header's own Size declaration (EXACT - a fully populated matrix, the catalogue's first); U-234 decay identity re-derived on all 54 initial-ratio cells (worst 1.3e-4); detrital correction direction and magnitude pinned; seawater initial-ratio window pinned; age span 11.657-25.044 ka with the LGM sample (25.044) at Hydrographers Passage; HYD/NOG = 14/13 split pinned; gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical dataset
